header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: stay away from them. If you are granted Jannah, you will receive all the blessings of Jannah. If you are protected from Jahannam, you will be protected from all the punishments of Jahannam” (so there is no need for those details in Du'a; asking for Jannah and seeking protection from Jahannam is sufficient), he said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ فِي اللَّيْلِ لَسَاعَةً لَا يُوَافِقُهَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَسْاَلُ اللهَ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَاْلآخِرَةِ إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ وَذلِكَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب في الليل ساعة مستجاب فيها الدعاء رقم:١٧٧٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “There is a time in the night; if any Muslim asks Allah at that time for something good of the affairs of this world and the Hereafter, Allah never fails to give it to him. That time occurs every night.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: يَنْزِلُ رَبُّنَا تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَي سَمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا حِينَ يَبْقي ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ اْلآخِرُ يَقُولُ: مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ يَسْاَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ مَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ له؟
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الدعاء والصلاة من اخر الليل رقم:١١٤٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “Every night, when a third of it remains, our Lord descends to the heaven of this world and says, “Who is there making Du'a to Me, that I may accept his Du'a? Who is there asking of Me, that I may give to him? Who is there seeking My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?”” — that the Prophet ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat
